report_issue_clusters.observed: The following transitions realise the condition the requirement states as a guard by writing it as the transition label, i.e. as the trigger event: (1) DoorsClosing -> InMotion: label `Closed/SendDeparted`, required guard 'doors are closed' (PlantUML line 5: `DoorsClosing --> InMotion : Closed/SendDeparted`) (2) Accelerating -> Cruising: label `Reached Cruising/Cruise`, required guard 'cruising speed is reached' (PlantUML line 12: `Accelerating --> Cruising : Reached Cruising/Cruise`) (3) Accelerating -> Approaching: label `Approached/Decelerate`, required guard 'system approaches its destination' (PlantUML line 13: `Accelerating --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`) (4) Cruising -> Approaching: label `Approached/Decelerate`, required guard 'system approaches the destination' (PlantUML line 14: `Cruising --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger; the closed model therefore declares one opaque event named after each condition and none of these transitions has a guard.
